svg.title: MARGIN VS. MARKUP: 20% / 25%
svg.desc: Cost 80, selling price 100, profit 20. Margin is 20 percent; markup is 25 percent.
svg.text: The percentage depends on what you divide by.
For a target margin: price = cost / (1 - margin)
Cost and price use the same tax basis and currency.
Educational reference; not professional advice. Errors may occur; verify calculations.
